lugares.name: Necoclí
lugares.subject: a Caribbean beach on the Gulf of Urabá with coconut palms, a wooden fishing canoe, turquoise sea and a low sunset sun

lugares.name: San Juan de Urabá
lugares.subject: a quiet Caribbean beach with fishing boats and palms at San Juan de Urabá

lugares.name: San Pedro de Urabá
lugares.subject: the main plaza and church of San Pedro de Urabá, Antioquia, Colombia, with the typical landscape of the Urabá subregion

lugares.name: Turbo
lugares.subject: a port on the Gulf of Urabá with banana boats and coconut palms in Turbo

lugares.name: Vigía del Fuerte
lugares.subject: stilt houses and dugout canoes on the wide Atrato river in the rainforest of Vigía del Fuerte

lugares.name: Cañón del Río Claro
lugares.subject: a white marble canyon with a turquoise river, caves and jungle at Cañón del Río Claro No church, no bell tower, no town plaza in this stamp.

lugares.name: Hacienda Nápoles
lugares.subject: hippos in a lagoon and giant dinosaur sculptures in a tropical park, Hacienda Nápoles No church, no bell tower, no town plaza in this stamp.

lugares.name: Doradal
lugares.subject: White-walled houses with clay tile roofs and hanging gardens climb above the broad Magdalena River at Doradal, while a boatman steers a wooden canoe past a waterfront promenade. No church, no bell tower, no town plaza in this stamp.

lugares.name: Cerro Tusa
lugares.subject: the pyramid-shaped mountain Cerro Tusa above coffee hills, a hiker on the summit trail

lugares.name: Plaza Botero
lugares.subject: Botero's voluptuous bronze sculptures in the plaza with the black-and-white gothic Palacio de la Cultura behind, Medellín

lugares.name: Jardín Botánico
lugares.subject: the wooden hexagonal flower-like canopy of the Orquideorama among tropical plants and orchids in the Medellín botanical garden

lugares.name: Comuna 13
lugares.subject: orange covered outdoor escalators on a hillside of red-brick houses with abstract graffiti murals (no readable words), Medellín valley behind

lugares.name: El Poblado
lugares.subject: tree-lined streets with tall modern buildings of El Poblado on the slopes of Medellín, green hills behind
